caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular banner or flag with a metallic or silver-gray textured background. At the center of the flag is an oval-shaped red area containing three gold lion-like animals, each positioned one above the other in a vertical line, all facing left. Surrounding the red oval is a broad blue circular band bordered in gold, with the inscription "HONI SOIT QUI MAL Y PENSE" written in gold letters. The overall composition is set against a plain, light background, with a faint rectangular border framing the flag drawing. Various indistinct shapes and text segments, colored in muted grays and pinks, are scattered in the silver background area outside the central shield and band.
title: Friendship Quilt Block
